prayerExcerpt.en-US: Go to Joseph. Whatever he tells you, do.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Ide a José. Fazei tudo o que ele vos disser.

meta.face: An older man around 60, balding with a high forehead and short silver-grey hair at the sides, a full neat rounded silver-grey beard, a tender fatherly smile toward the Child.
meta.basis: The older, balding, greying Joseph common on 19th-century cards; rounded beard from the Painter's Manual.

sources.title: Dionysius of Fourna, The Painter's Manual (Hermeneia), c. 1730 — Didron's 1845 French edition

history.note: Face edited to break the stock look-alike face shared by most male cards
Chosen over the vigorous dark-haired type, which matched Luke and Mark
